program.name: Pilates Volume
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: Three long mat sessions: abs, then back and sides, then glutes and rolling.
program.about: Long Pilates sessions with one focus each. The hundred opens every one; then the abdominal series one day, back extension and side work the next, and glutes with rolling and control the third. Three days rotate. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves.
